name: Walker X
specs_note: OWNER-APPROVED 2026-10-31 (Robert Konecny, in thread; PR #222); unpublished, publication is a separate decision. RETRIEVAL: AUTOMATED weekly new-robot scan 2026-10-31 (HO-DATA-STANDING); values verbatim from https://www.ubtrobot.com/en/humanoid/products/walker-x. Not human-verified. Page meta description: 'UBTECH Walker X is a next-generation humanoid robot designed for AI research, smart services, and human-robot interaction. Discover advanced mobility, intelligent perception, and real-world applications.' Specification values were not retrievable from the static page, so all specs are null. Relationship to catalogued Walker S1/S2/Tienkung is not stated on the page and is not inferred. SELLER ENRICHMENT 2026-10-31: height, weight and mobility from the RobotLAB listing https://www.robotlab.com/store/walker-humanoid-service-robot/ ('Model / platform: Walker X (research edition)'); the seller says it is its research-edition offering, so the edition match to UBTECH's Walker X page is unconfirmed. PRICE: none recorded. RobotLAB's page contradicts itself ($250,000 in its price fields, $960,000 in two prose passages); the owner ruled on 2026-10-31 that neither is a realistic or confirmed offer, so the price stays unknown until a valid offer is confirmed.

use_case_fits.notes: UBTECH describes Walker X as designed for AI research, smart services and human-robot interaction. Manufacturer positioning only.
use_case_fits.limitations: No deployments or demonstrations are recorded; fit rests on the maker's stated purpose only.

spec_caveats.text: RobotLAB states 1.45 m for its 'Walker X (research edition)' listing (seller page https://www.robotlab.com/store/walker-humanoid-service-robot/); not stated on UBTECH's own page.
RobotLAB states 77 kg for the same listing; seller figure, not manufacturer-stated.
RobotLAB describes it as a 'Full-size bipedal humanoid robot'.
Left null: RobotLAB lists 36 DoF but adds 'per RobotLAB page; manufacturer lists higher on current Walker X'.
